bases.source:
A post-hoc sensitivity analysis of the primary outcome (see table further) showed that the LOCF results were
similar to 3 other imputation methods: linear interpolation, maximum likelihood analysis (no case wise deletion
by SAS Proc Mixed), and Markov chain Monte-Carlo (MCMC) multiply imputation that is suitable for arbitrary
missing patterns. This comparison showed that the BTX-A clinical efficacy was invariant whatever the method
of imputation used.

LOCF is one of the different methods of imputation that can be applied to datasets containing few missing data.
In the present study, out of 1650 data points for weekly pain (primary outcome) (66 x 25 records) only 131
(7.9 %) were missing, and out of 396 data points (66 x 6 visits), 29 (7.3 %) were missing. Because they were
more prevalent at the end of the 24 weeks period mostly due to dropouts (time effect, Friedman test: p<0.0001)
and more prevalent in the placebo group (2-sample Wilcoxon test: p=0.043) the missing pattern was identified as
Missing at Random (MAR). No baseline effect on the missingness was detected, thereby ruling out a Missing
Not at Random (MNAR) pattern.

mitigation_answer.justification: A post-hoc sensitivity analysis compared LOCF with linear interpolation, maximum likelihood mixed-model analysis, and MCMC multiple imputation and reported that clinical efficacy was invariant across methods. This supports probable robustness of the treatment effect, although the report does not show sensitivity to departures from the MAR assumption or plausible MNAR scenarios, and missingness was more common in placebo and late follow-up.
unknowns: No sensitivity analysis under explicitly MNAR assumptions is reported.

hypothesis: Agreement across LOCF/interpolation/ML/MCMC under shared missingness assumptions may not resolve plausibility of outcome-related late/differential dropout. Saved probably_yes closes D3 Low while acknowledging untested departures from MAR. Need assess method assumptions against actual reasons/timing/approved pain trajectory, not count named methods or stable estimates.
countercontrol: nefigard selected Table S2 explicitly conditions alternative missing-data imputation on treatment duration and post-12-month UPCR; more mechanism-specific, still not an automatic proof of unbiasedness.
status: Priority scientific audit candidate, not confirmed label error; no label revision or inference performed
